acceptanceCriteria: corvint affected with only docs/specs/README.md dirty no longer selects either package

internal/tasks/authority and internal/tasks/store produce identical per-test go test -json outcomes unconfined and under .github/testconfine in the CI container, and carry a measured entry in .corvint/test-read-scopes.json
body: Found 2026-10-01 while measuring floor packages for AFP-V0-023 declarations (PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/452, build log docs/build-log/2026-10-01-declared-floor-read-scopes.md). internal/tasks/authority and internal/tasks/store are on the unbounded-reader floor because of repository literals in fixture data, and together cost about 430 package-seconds per merge (authority 307, store 124 in the 16-merge attribution). Expected: a declared read scope confines them. Actual: both pass unconfined and fail under the Landlock wrapper in golang:1.27.1 (Landlock ABI 4), because the Tasks store opens / to walk a path one component at a time and Landlock cannot grant / without granting the whole tree. Options: make the store's component walk start below the root it needs (for example openat from an allowed ancestor), or confine these packages by another mechanism. Corvint version: branch build of claude/declare-floor-read-scopes (AFP-V0-023 planner).
title: tests: let the Tasks store packages run under a declared read scope (the store opens /, which Landlock cannot grant)
